advisory_findings.description: Codex 0.147 interactive launch reached the TUI without reliably submitting the prompt after the trust gate. The canonical PTY driver needs a version-aware submission path.

The first Codex advisory schema omitted strict additionalProperties=false constraints. The schema was repaired, but the lane was not rerun to a valid reply because the provider path also hit certificate/network failures.
TD_PRODUCTS has 169 records but 168 unique ids because OpenCode is duplicated historically. User-facing copy now says records and documents the duplicate instead of claiming 169 unique products.

notes: No reviewer lane is represented as PASS.
No reviewer emitted a P0/P1 finding before its infrastructure failure.
Mechanical verification does not replace the four independent binding reviews.
